newsitem.title: USA: MECON sees Q4 net loss between $1.7-$1.9mln.
newsitem.headline: MECON sees Q4 net loss between $1.7-$1.9mln.

text.p: MECON Inc said on Monday it expected to report net revenues of about $2.4 million and a pre-tax loss in the range of $1.7 million to $1.9 million for the three months ended March 31 because of a significant and unanticipated shortfall in orders.

The company, which provides benchmarking data and cost management tools for healthcare delivery systems, also said it expected to report net revenues of about $13.5 million and a pre-tax loss in the range of $2.2 million to $2.4 million for the fiscal year ended March 31.
It said the results were preliminary and subject to adjustments.

Results reflected reduced productivity which occurred as a result of the ongoing implementation of MECON's corporate restructuring announced in November, it said. The company said it would announce corrective steps later in May.
